rules.text: `tabulate` MUST align numeric columns with `numalign` and all other columns with `stralign`.

evidence.quote: aligns = [numalign if ct in [int, float] else stralign for ct in coltypes]

rules.text: `tabulate` MUST pad numbers aligned as `decimal` so that their decimal points line up.
`tabulate` MUST replace a `None` value with `missingval`.
`tabulate` MUST format float values with `floatfmt`, which defaults to `g`.
`tabulate` MUST format integer values with `intfmt`.
`tabulate` MUST treat a string that looks like a whole number as an integer.
`tabulate` MUST keep the original text of a column when number parsing is disabled for it with `disable_numparse`.
`tabulate` MUST use the keys of a dict of columns as the headers when `headers="keys"`.
`tabulate` MUST take the headers from the first row, leaving it out of the data, when `headers="firstrow"`.
`tabulate` MUST build the columns of a list of dicts from the keys in first-seen order, with a missing key giving a `None` cell.

evidence.quote: rows = [[row.get(k) for k in keys] for row in rows]

rules.text: `tabulate` MUST prepend a row-index column when `showindex="always"`.

evidence.quote: elif showindex == "always" or (_bool(showindex) and not showindex_is_a_str):

rules.text: `tabulate` MUST raise `ValueError` when an explicit `showindex` sequence does not have one value per row.

evidence.quote: "index must be as long as the number of data rows: "

rules.text: `tabulate` MUST raise `TypeError` when the tabular data is not iterable.
`tabulate` MUST return an empty string for a table that has no headers and no rows.
`tabulate` MUST draw a horizontal line in place of a row that is `SEPARATING_LINE`.
`simple_separated_format` MUST return a format whose header and data rows join the cells with the given separator.
The `pipe` format MUST mark a right-aligned or decimal-aligned column with a trailing colon in its header line.
`tabulate` MUST apply a single integer `maxcolwidths` to every column.
`tabulate` MUST let `colalign` override the alignment of an individual column.
The `html` format MUST escape the cell text.
